channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 3 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 3: The Block 3 page now says the Design for Development's…
item.description: The Block 3 page now says the Design for Development's note 13, which required one of five commercial blocks to be deed-restricted for life science use, no longer applies: the Planning Commission removed that requirement on July 28, 2022. Whether the note's wording in the Design for Development was itself changed was not checked. Source: https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf ; https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 3: Block 3's expected completion is now 2031, from…
item.description: Block 3's expected completion is now 2031, from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Phase 2, vertical development 2029-2031), instead of the 2035 whole-project target. The life-science deed-restriction fact now says the Planning Commission's Resolution 21156 (July 28, 2022) removed the requirement to dedicate a 130,000 sq ft building to life science. The mapping notes no longer call the site vacant land with no address: DataSF Parcels shows the footprint within the much larger active lot 4175028 (1241 Delaware St). The unsourced 'secondhand description' contrast was removed, mapping sources now cite the final D4D (Feb 26, 2020) instead of a dead 2019 draft link, and the D4D publisher is shown as SF Planning. Source: SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); SF Planning Commission, Resolution No. 21156, 2022-07-28 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf).

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 3: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020… (~2031)
item.description: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists Block 3 in Phase 2 with vertical development 2029-2031 (Block 3 is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list: Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) (~2031). Source: SocketSite, 2020-10-09; SF Planning, 2020-10-07.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 3: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 3 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning, 2020-02-26.
